rationale: Glucose depleted; switching to lactate + arabinose + amino acid fermentation. Lactate oxidation and pentose fermentation provide 57 mmol C/gDW/h. Growth at 0.35 /h consumes 13.3 mmol C/gDW/h (38×0.35) and 3.5 mmol N/gDW/h. Remaining 43.7 mmol C/gDW/h released as mixed-acid fermentation products (acetate, butyrate, formate, CO₂). Nitrogen balanced via arginine + serine + ammonium.
